caption: The drawing depicts the exterior of a building facade, featuring two large, shuttered windows positioned side by side, with a wrought-iron balcony railing running horizontally in front of them. The shutters on both windows are composed of horizontal slats and are colored in varying shades of brown, matching the overall sepia tone of the image. The balcony railing is decorated with repeating intricate geometric and floral patterns, and each vertical section of the railing has detailed ornamentation, including stylized plant-like motifs and symmetrical curves, predominantly outlined in dark brown or black. The background wall is plain and light beige, contributing to the high contrast between the solid forms of the shutters and the airy, ornate design of the ironwork. The lower portion of the image shows part of the underside of the balcony platform, depicted in darker brown tones with diagonal supporting beams visible. The composition is highly symmetrical, with both the windows and the railing segments evenly spaced within the rectangular frame of the drawing.
title: Cast Iron Balcony Rail
